method: Direct inspection of unedited UE screenshots, separate red-reticle pixel measurement, and nominal-pose ray/triangle checks.

observations.owner_aperture: Central viewing aperture clear at standing/crouched pitch 0,+35,-35; small iron-sight prongs remain only at the lower edge. Reticle is inside the lens, not on the obstructing receiver.
observations.owner_actions: Hip and sampled reload retain the raised optic/adapter. The swap-back frame is before the attachment event and still shows the other rifle; committed actor/attachment identity is covered by runtime assertions, not inferred from that frame.
observations.detach: Optic and riser removed, original iron-sight view restored. Reattaching returns the reticle to the same center.
observations.observer: Raised-aim left/right/front-top frames expose the optic mount. Adapter sits on the receiver; optic base seats on the adapter. No obvious floating gap or receiver penetration in these samples.
observations.previous_review: The old acceptance identified a centered point but missed aperture occlusion; historical files are retained unchanged.

limits: Selected steady poses and action samples only. One rendered client per run; NullRHI peers are not visual evidence. Same-host editor-game Development/Null scope, no new package.
